scientific_limitations: Only embedded smooth ring-torus surfaces with R>r>0, independent area-uniform points, Euclidean chord distance; fixed-shape epsilon asymptotics only; not intrinsic, volume or degenerate torus models. title: Sharp near-diameter chord tails and a unique shape optimum for ring-torus surfaces
